market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to roughly 3-4x from current levels (~$32) to $120 in just over a year, surpassing its all-time high of ~$50 by a wide margin. No fundamental or speculative catalyst suggests such a move; historically, silver’s largest annual gains are far smaller. The market-implied 6.7% probability is an order of magnitude too high.
evidence_points: CME Silver (SI) front-month futures settled around $32 in early March 2025
Silver’s all-time high is approximately $50, set in 1980 and revisited in 2011
The largest 1-year rally in silver (2009-2010) was about 80%, far short of the 275%+ needed to reach $120
